summary: Decode BOM-tagged UTF16 timed text without garbling Unicode or malformed-cue recovery

before.specific_failure: Both parsers preserve exact packets and actual video; native text treats UTF16 as lossy UTF8 or drops it, including empty/invalid Unicode distinctions.
before.introduced_prefix_regression: An initial helper drops a valid canonical UTF8 string resembling a modifier box;2pass2fail before a complete-layout guard. Corrected before acceptance; no extra improvement counted.

standard.scope: Required UTF16BE BOM plus optional reversed byte order; legacy grouped/boxed forms are compatibility extensions.

uncounted: Valid UTF8 prefix/padding preservation and initial decoder correction
Complete default font descriptors for FVID-0422 witnesses; original timestamp failure remains1pass2fail on valid descriptors
Encoding/wrapper/empty/refusal variants and fixture names retained via identical-byte mapping
limits: Malformed cues are skipped while healthy text/video are retained; not a whole-file refusal claim
Finite subsystem and native-paint/seek checks, not whole-project or physical-device qualification

final_fixture_descriptor_qualification.change: Empty text modifier ranges use0..0 rather than0..1. Text bytes, clocks, lengths, source pictures and production code are unchanged.
